entry.title: New: Resolution 605 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — GOEAC-150: Recommended adoption - 07/22/26
entry.content:
DIRECTS THE COUNTY CLERK TO TAKE NECESSARY ACTION TO PLACE THE CHARTER AMENDMENT PROPOSED BY ORDINANCE NO. 26-47, RELATING TO THE OFFICE OF THE COUNTY AUDITOR, ON THE 2026 GENERAL ELECTION BALLOT

Proposes to clarify that the County Auditor has the same power with respect to employees within the Office of the County Auditor as department heads in the Executive Branch and specifies that the County Auditor may appoint a deputy.

Latest action: GOEAC-150: Recommended adoption - 07/22/26
